crates/symphony-api/Cargo.toml.proof: Serde runtime wire types; serde_json and the std-only reporting reader are test dependencies. The reporting reader is ../repository-read in this owning Symphony workspace. The crate reads [workspace.lints], a lint table and no input. Standard targets, no custom build or external source paths; both workspace manifests, lockfiles, toolchain/configuration and feature-unification inputs remain audited.

crates/symphony-api/src/lib.rs.proof: Wire data types, serde implementations and value methods. Includes only the agent_probes, agents, blocks, machine_work, media, project, task_queries and task_stage modules; no filesystem, environment or process reads. Serde receives values from callers and performs no repository I/O. The front's plugins, pin, schema and projects fields are plain serde values. The queue_category helper splits its supplied path string only; it performs no path resolution or I/O. The task offer and its TASK_ACTION_ROUTE constant are a struct and a string literal only. Card::href formats its own fields, and the Change reader visits the supplied serde map, in memory. TaskPage defaults missing machine evidence to the separately inventoried MachineWork value; agents wire records are in the separately inventoried agents module. TaskListing moved to the separately inventoried task_stage module and is re-exported with TaskStage; the task-domain types and queries re-export the separately inventoried task_queries module.

crates/symphony-api/src/agents.rs.proof: Agents, Agent, AgentSlots, HeldTask, AgentRun and AgentSaid are wire records with serde and comparison derives. Agents defaults its caller-supplied machine_work field through the separately inventoried MachineWork value. AgentSlots contains two counts only. No filesystem, environment or process reads, source includes or initialization I/O.

crates/symphony-api/src/machine_work.rs.proof: Serde-only machine observation records, operation kinds/states, freshness enums, execution counts and advisory WorkGuidance values. Default derives construct unknown evidence, empty vectors and an empty guidance map from values only. Machine ids, producer ids, checkout strings, receiver ages and optional build/test targets are caller values, never paths, clocks or configuration read by this module. No filesystem, environment or process reads, includes or custom initialization.

crates/symphony-api/src/task_queries.rs.proof: TaskKind and TaskStatus are value enums; status spelling is a match over string literals. Task methods inspect only the caller's parent and status fields. The task/subtask and lifecycle queries filter the caller's borrowed slice in memory. Unit tests construct Task records and strings in memory, including nested slices, unknown states and empty inputs. No filesystem, environment, process reads, macros with external inputs or includes.

crates/symphony-api/src/project.rs.proof: The ProjectView, NavItem and PROJECT_ELEMENT wire values with serde derives. The base helpers (here, strip) and the route helpers (entrypoints, is_document_route, is_folder_route, documents_href, readme_route) and the within helper compare and format the caller's strings against the SYMPHONY_ROUTES string literals; is_markdown reads the supplied name's extension with Path::extension, in memory. Tests build values in memory; no filesystem, environment, process reads or includes.

crates/symphony-api/src/agent_probes.rs.proof: The agents view's probe wire type with serde derives. Its try_from and into conversions move the caller's strings between AgentProbes and a private wire struct in memory; its unit tests encode and decode literal JSON values only. No filesystem, environment or process reads.

crates/symphony-api/src/blocks.rs.proof: Document wire types and vocabulary macro. Macro expansion is enum/string conversion and serde only; no repository I/O.

crates/symphony-api/src/media.rs.proof: Media wire types (Media, GalleryItem, Viewer, View) with serde derives. element_html, encoded, decode, is_name, is_element and escape format, split and compare the caller's strings in memory with std::fmt::Write; its unit tests build values only. No filesystem, environment or process reads.

crates/symphony-api/tests/wire.rs.proof: fixture constructs the same process-edge reporting Reader with the absolute compiling API crate as its default root, preserving an active report's explicit audit root. It passes CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/fixtures and literal file names to the inventoried helper. The reader_tests module owns only synthetic scratch data and isolated child audit contexts, separately inventoried. The separately inventoried machine_work module constructs value-only wire cases. All remaining serialization/assertions are in memory.

crates/symphony-api/tests/wire/machine_w.proof: Private fixtures are literal JSON values constructed by serde_json::json. Tests deserialize legacy Agents, TaskListing and TaskPage values, check the default empty guidance map and supplied numeric advice, and serialize machine reservations and stale evidence in memory. They call no fixture file reader and read no filesystem, environment, process state or clock.

crates/symphony-api/tests/wire/fixture.r.proof: The only I/O is Reader::read_to_string on the explicit fixtures folder joined with name, without canonicalizing or replacing the audited read. wire.rs supplies its compiling crate's absolute fixtures folder; reader_tests supplies owned scratch folders. The same reporting file boundary runs in preselection across the declared API fixture directory; no raw filesystem bypass.

crates/symphony-api/tests/wire/reader_te.proof: Tests create and remove uniquely owned temporary folders, payloads, links and derived audit reports. Subject reads always use the inventoried fixture helper and unchanged Reader; raw filesystem reads inspect only these derived reports. The isolated current native test executable is a derived build output; its private mode/default variables and audit root/report are set only on each owned child Command. Active, missing-root, relative-root and inactive-report cases use synthetic scratch roots, never repository inputs or process-global environment mutation. No external executable, source lookup, provider or parent-project fixture is used.

crates/symphony-api/src/task_stage.rs.proof: TaskListing is a serde wire record with caller-supplied task/machine values, counters and cursors; serde defaults construct empty values only. TaskStage contains borrowed lifecycle text and fixed Build/Test variants; PIPELINE and as_str use string literals. MachineWork::task_stage and conflicts inspect only the caller's connection flag, task lifecycle/slug, machine freshness, operation identity/kind/state and value equality. Ranking and conflict checks neither read clocks nor resolve checkout strings; no filesystem, environment, process reads or includes. The cfg(test) tests module is inventoried separately.

crates/symphony-api/src/task_stage/tests.proof: Fixtures are literal serde_json values decoded into caller-owned Task, WorkOperation and MachineWork records. Tests mutate and compare these in-memory values, reverse operation vectors and call the separately inventoried pure task-stage/status methods. No fixture files, clocks, environment, process state, source includes or other I/O are read.

crates/repository-read/Cargo.toml.proof: Std-only library, no build script, macros or dependencies. No test runner data is read at initialization.

crates/repository-read/src/lib.rs.proof: No autonomous repository reads: all I/O is requested by caller paths. Attempt is recorded before opening, listing or metadata; component resolution reports every followed link and resolved path. Report I/O is a verifier-owned derived output, not a source input. Process only adapts the explicit audit root/report environment; gate supplies values through Env. The content JSON traversal delegates to these reporting methods; its separate display prefix affects errors only, never read/report paths. Caller proofs and runtime comparison cover the supplied paths; all bypasses would change this source proof.
